messages:
zoe: Noticed a bunch of mobile SSE clients reconnecting in short bursts from our ap-south edge. Looks like a keepalive jitter around 200-700ms causing clients to hit their local retry logic.
raj: Any evidence it's the edge and not the client-side radios? can we correlate with pod GC/times?
zoe: Correlation: spikes align with a few pods entering safepoint. sample log: 
```
2026-03-23T11:02:10Z EDGE pause=ms:560 pod=svc-rt-12 gc=true route=/v1/stream/user/abc
2026-03-23T11:02:11Z CLIENT agent=mobile/2.3.1 reconnect_reason=keepalive_miss delta=620ms
```
kevin: If client reconnects before server acknowledges resume, the runtime treats it as new and we charge twice. Billing flagged a 2.4x increase for that route during the window.
zoe: I propose a three-prong approach: a) short client debounce on our SDK (200ms randomized); b) server-side grace_period_ms increase behind flag; c) dashboard telemetry to catch micro-spikes.
raj: For telemetry, can we surface a small-scope metric: "sse_microburst_count" defined as >3 reconnects from same token within 5s? that would make these bursts visible in Console.
console-bot: Idea acked. Also suggest a sparkline panel for 1m/5m reconnect-rate and a table of top user_agents. we can show probe hits too.
kevin: About billing: temporary mitigations include a 2s billing-dedupe window keyed on resume_token + session_id. But as a safeguard, if resumed_request produced >200 tokens we mark it billable regardless.
zoe: Agree on conservative billing fallback. Also infra: can we emit an explicit "edge-probe" event immediately after any GC pause so clients get a ping sooner?
infra-bot: We can add a lightweight probe (single byte) post-pause. Need to evaluate NPS impact and CPU. planning: small canary on ap-south only.
raj: UX for console: when a team changes grace_period_ms we should show an explanation tooltip and an auto-suggest: "Use only to mitigate infra jitter; investigate pods with frequent safepoints." Also require confirmation for >1000ms.
kevin: Good call. Add an audit log entry for changes to per-route grace.
zoe: Action items: 
- infra: implement post-pause probe canary in ap-south (infra-bot)
- runtime: implement feature-flagged grace_period_ms bump and billing-dedupe (kevin)
- sdk: add jittered reconnect debounce on mobile SDK default (zoe)
- console: add sse_microburst_count metric + panel + edit guardrails (raj)

raj: I'll mock the panel and a tooltip copy. Zoe, can you draft the SDK small debounce PR?
zoe: On it. I'll include examples for iOS/Android and note the recommended client timeout = server_grace * 2.
kevin: I'll prototype billing-dedupe this afternoon and run a sim against the sample logs.
console-bot: Reminders: gate runtime flag behind rollout (0.5% -> 5% -> 50%), add alert if microburst_count > baseline*4.
zoe: Thanks all. we'll reconvene after PRs are up. :rocket:
